01 — Investment Opportunity

Why this opportunity
stands out

A rent/lease revenue model positioning Grade-A office, co-working, F&B, and IT park spaces within India's most vibrant commercial growth corridor. Multi-tenant diversification with institutional-grade operations.

Market Gap
East Pune's Manjari-Hadapsar corridor lacks modern Grade-A commercial office supply. Existing institutional-quality space is concentrated 15+ km away in Magarpatta and Hadapsar.
Rental Growth
Annual office rental growth of 8-12% expected as the corridor matures. Early-mover landlords secure above-market lease escalations in emerging micro-markets.
Tenant Diversity
Multiple revenue streams: IT, co-working, corporate offices, F&B, retail. De-risks concentration risk and maximizes average occupancy rates.
Institutional Quality
Purpose-built asset, professional property management, and long-term leases with institutional tenants ensure predictable cash flows and exit optionality.
02 — Location & Accessibility

Strategic positioning in Pune's fastest-growing commercial corridor

Magnacity Township's commercial sector (CS-2) benefits from exceptional multi-directional road access, proximity to planned residential population, and integrated township infrastructure.

Multi-Directional Access
18m + 24m road frontage with direct connectivity to Pune's major arterial routes. Seamless link to Solapur Highway, bypass, and Pune International Airport (25 km).
Prime Connectivity Highway Access
Residential Catchment
Multiple large residential sectors within 1 km radius. Immediate workforce population of 50,000+ growing 20% annually. Built-in employee base and tenant pipeline.
Captive Workforce Dense Population
Infrastructure-Ready
Township-wide utilities, drainage, and MEP pre-planned by Kumar Realty. No independent off-site infrastructure investment. Full municipal approvals in place.
Utilities Ready No Delays
Commercial Zoning
CS-2 designation under UDCPR regulations fully compliant for office, retail, and mixed-use development. No restrictive covenant; approved for multi-tenant commercial operations.
Regulatory Approved Fast-Track Approvals
03 — Facility Scope & Components

Diverse amenities for institutional
& occupier appeal

A flexible, mixed-use commercial facility tailored to contemporary workplace needs. Each component sized to optimize occupancy, rental yield, and tenant retention.

🏢
Grade-A Office Floors
Column-free floorplates (1,200-1,500 sq.m each). Modular design supports single-tenant anchors or multi-tenant configurations. Premium finishes, raised flooring, and 100% DG backup.
👨‍💼
Co-Working & Flexible Space
2-3 dedicated co-working floors with hot-desks, private cabins, meeting pods. High-margin revenue segment with rapid tenant turnover and premium pricing.
☕
Food & Beverage Retail
Ground floor double-height café, restaurants, and F&B retail (1,500+ sq.ft). Prime location ensures high footfall, attractive to emerging F&B brands and cloud kitchens.
💻
IT & Tech Park
Dedicated IT-compliant floors with enhanced cabling infrastructure, 24/7 NOC support, and secure access controls. Optimized for software, BPO, and tech companies.
🏬
Premium Retail & Showroom
Ground + 1st floor retail spaces (500-1,000 sq.ft each) for corporate services, high-end retail, and corporate showrooms. High visibility from main roads.
🚗
Smart Parking & Logistics
Structured + surface parking (500+ spaces). Dedicated drop-off zones, valet service, electric vehicle charging. Seamless internal vehicle circulation and service access.
📋
Business Centre & Events
Boardrooms, training halls, and multi-purpose event space (800 sq.m) with AV infrastructure and catering facilities. Premium tenant amenity and revenue generator.
🌳
Wellness & Common Areas
Rooftop gardens, wellness center, yoga studio, and landscaped podium commons. Enhances tenant retention, supports ESG positioning, and commands premium rental rates.
Design & Operational Flexibility

All components are modular and reconfigurable. Retail can be converted to co-working, office floors can be subdivided for multi-tenant lettings, F&B space can adapt to market demand. This flexibility ensures optimal occupancy and rental yield across market cycles.

04 — Lease & Rental Models

Revenue structure & investor
options

Multiple rental and occupancy models available depending on investor profile and risk appetite. Select a model below to explore details.

Long-Term Lease Model
Devyog constructs the facility and leases it on a long-term basis to institutional operators, corporate users, and multi-tenant occupancy. Predictable rental income with escalation clauses.
  • Lease tenure: 9-15 years with annual rent escalation (5-8% indexed)
  • Diversified tenant mix reduces single-tenant risk
  • Property management handled professionally by Devyog
  • Rental yield target: 15-18% (net of costs)
  • High-quality institutional tenants ensure payment reliability
Ideal For
"Institutional investors, pension funds, and REITs seeking stable, long-duration, inflation-linked rental income from Grade-A commercial assets."
Institutional Anchor Model
Single large tenant or co-anchor partnership occupying 40-60% of the facility (25,000-40,000 sq.ft). Devyog retains remaining space for multi-tenant lettings and F&B retail.
  • Anchor lease secures stable base income; remaining space generates high-margin variable income
  • Anchor's brand presence attracts quality tenants to flex space
  • Blended yield improves with quality anchorages
  • Typical anchor: IT services, corporate HQ, or BPO operations
  • Anchor investment stabilizes project returns and de-risks ramp-up phase
Ideal For
"Co-investors or PE funds seeking institutional anchor partnerships that reduce occupancy risk while retaining upside from remaining flex space."
Mixed-Use Blended Occupancy
Optimize each component independently: premium office floors on long-term leases, co-working on flex terms, F&B on revenue-share, retail on short-term leases. Maximize blended yield.
  • Office (60%): 9-12 year leases at ₹60-80/sq.ft/month
  • Co-working (15%): High-margin flex occupancy with rapid tenant rotation
  • F&B Retail (15%): Revenue-share at 8-10% of gross or fixed rental hybrid
  • Blended yield target: 16-20% with diversified income streams
  • Reduces concentration risk; optimal for market volatility
Ideal For
"Active investors and operators seeking portfolio diversification with multiple revenue streams and flexibility to adapt to market cycles."
Built-to-Suit Sale / REIT Exit
Develop the facility to institutional-grade standards and sell to institutional capital, REITs, or PE funds seeking stabilized commercial income assets. Premium valuation for institutional-grade assets.
  • Asset constructed to REIT-compliant standards and governance
  • Pre-leased with long-term institutional tenants (>70% occupancy at handover)
  • Turnkey delivery to buyer; zero development execution risk for acquirer
  • REIT yield: 6-8% at stabilized NOI; capital gain on REIT listing premium
  • Developer exits with capital gain; institutional buyer secures stable yield asset
Ideal For
"Developers seeking institutional exit; REITs acquiring pipeline assets; and PE funds building commercial real estate portfolios for long-term hold."
